title: Viney Monroe, who helped raise him
summary: Zutty explains that Viney Monroe worked for his mother in Bunkie and helped bring him up and take him around, though she was not a musician.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: That is one thing that I like, That let's you know if you left the, if you've left the volume up on the ......... When did Monroe come in the picture?
Well (Viney Monroe?) looked like she used to work for my mother in Bunkie.

See then from then on she just raised me right on up. You know, Viney Monroe, because she had two sons and a daughter and they didn't call her by the real name. It was Sissy Viney, Bud Viney and Daniel Viney. They'd call....
Yes. But her name was Viney Monroe.
Was she a musician in any way?
Oh, but she just, she helped bring you up?
Helped bring me up. Take me around you know. Yes, she worked with me, believe me.
